research.notes: Could not confirm the organization. OUSD's agreement lists 'Jones Environmental Services, Oakland, CA' signed by one named owner at a residential-looking Oakland street address, which may be a sole proprietorship (individual), and the agenda also mentions Antioch. A LinkedIn page for 'Jones Environmental Services, LLC' (founded 2007, woman-owned, website jonesenvsvcs.com) exists, but its website no longer resolves, no location was shown, and nothing ties it to Oakland/Antioch or OUSD. Jones Environmental, Inc. (Santa Fe Springs, CA; jonesenv.com) is a different company. No registry record was found to confirm a match.
